context.description: The directory is free once the run machine is final, even while the summary waits

evidence.trustReason: Given real root permission wait and When final done run are asserted. The next /task passes the busy check; one summary follows permission reply, or a deleted root logs one failure. But the Then writer-before-release order is not asserted: the test waits for a free lease and only afterward reads a done status. A release-before-write race could pass. The separate SV21 test observes release, but UI24 does not prove this order under its waiting-summary path.

context.gherkin:
Scenario: UI24 The directory is free once the run machine is final, even while the summary waits
    Given a root session whose turn waits on a permission prompt
    When the run actor reaches done
    Then the lease is released after the writer writes the done snapshot and before the summary
    And the next /task in the directory is not busy
    And the summary is written once, when the root turn ends, or its failure is logged when the root session goes away

  @phase4 @compat
